subject: Aurora AI — subvendor transition / order-form amendment (EdgeCache) — review & next steps
messages:
From: Anna Mills <anna.mills@auroraai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: legal-contact@auroraai.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: Subvendor addition (EdgeCache Systems) + proposed order form amendment

Hi Soojin,

Quick heads-up from Procurement — Aurora is adding EdgeCache Systems as a subvendor to support CDN and log buffering for the Redwood integration. Per our MSA section 9.2, we are providing this formal notice and attaching the change package for your legal review. Attachments: Aurora-Subvendor-Change-Notice.pdf, EdgeCache-SOC2-summary.pdf.

High-level: EdgeCache will only process encrypted request metadata and transient logs; they will not receive customer PII. We expect the change to be operational by June 1, and Aurora is proposing a short Order Form amendment (attached OF-Amendment-EdgeCache.docx) to add EdgeCache as an approved subprocessor and to add a DPA addendum reference.

Requests:
- Please confirm by 2026-05-11 whether Redwood can accept the proposed flow-down language (we can extend review window if needed).
- If you require material redlines to the Order Form or DPA, please provide them as tracked changes; we need to route to our legal by 2026-05-14 to keep the go-live date.

Point of contact on our side is me (anna.mills@auroraai.com) and legal-contact@auroraai.com.

Thanks — Anna
Anna Mills
Senior Procurement Manager, Aurora AI

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Mills <anna.mills@auroraai.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: Subvendor addition (EdgeCache Systems) + proposed order form amendment

Anna — thanks for the notice and the attachments. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Rishi (privacy) for review, and Karthik to flag procurement constraints.

Quick next steps from our side:
- Kimberly / Legal: can you triage the attached Order Form amendment + DPA addendum and call out any hard stops (audit access, data residency, indemnity)?
- Rishi / Privacy: please confirm whether the data categories described in the SOC2 summary change our handling or require contractual guardrails.
- Karthik / Procurement: if legal approves with redlines, can we commit to a 7–10 day turnaround to negotiate?

We generally accept subprocessor flow-downs where the subvendor has SOC2 and limited data access, but I want to be explicit about our position on live data access and audit rights before we sign onto an amendment.

I’ll capture any questions in a short checklist and send back by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Anna Mills <anna.mills@auroraai.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: Subvendor addition (EdgeCache Systems) + proposed order form amendment

Thanks — reviewed the OF-Amendment-EdgeCache.docx and DPA addendum draft. I attached a redline (OF-Redline-EdgeCache.docx) with comments; key items below:

Summary of legal concerns (high priority):
- Audit & access: The proposed language limits Redwood's right to audit EdgeCache to "reasonable notice". We need explicit audit and log access rights (at minimum quarterly) to validate data handling and retention practices.
- Data scope: The amendment does not clearly exclude telemetry that could contain customer identifiers. Request explicit carve-outs and a data minimization clause.
- Subcontracting & onward transfers: Aurora's draft gives unlimited downstream subcontracting rights. Propose a change to require prior written consent for any security-impacting subcontractors and 30-day notice for other subcontractors.
- Indemnity & liability: The cap language is inconsistent with the MSA. We propose harmonizing liability caps to match existing MSA section 11.

Operational asks: please confirm whether EdgeCache will have any persistent token or key material (service account keys) that could be used outside Aurora's environment — that affects our KMS/HSM controls.

Attachments: OF-Redline-EdgeCache.docx (redlines + comment log). I recommend we hold a 30-minute call with Aurora's legal to walk through the redlines rather than multiple email threads. Availability tomorrow 10:00–12:00 PT.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Anna Mills <anna.mills@auroraai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: legal-contact@auroraai.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 07:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: Subvendor addition (EdgeCache Systems) + proposed order form amendment

Kim / Soojin — appreciate the quick review and detailed comments. We can accept most of the redlines but need to confirm a few items internally.

Responses to your points:
- Audit & access: Aurora is willing to permit audit access for log verification. We prefer a quarterly remote audit plus on-site with reasonable notice. Will accept explicit language for quarterly remote log access.
- Data scope: EdgeCache will only receive hashed request identifiers by default; occasional unmasked IDs may be used for troubleshooting under strict controls. We will add a clear data minimization clause in the amendment.
- Onward subcontracting: We can add a prior written consent requirement for security-impacting subcontractors; for non-security-impacting subvendors we will provide 30-day notice.
- KMS keys: EdgeCache will not hold long-lived customer keys. They will use short-lived tokens provisioned by Aurora.

Attached is an updated OF-Amendment-EdgeCache.docx and a link to a DocuSign envelope for the amendment: https://docusign.com/aurora/ENVELOPE-8897. We'll plan for a 30-minute call — are you available 2026-05-07 10:00 PT?

Best,
Anna

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Mills <anna.mills@auroraai.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 20:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Notice: Subvendor addition (EdgeCache Systems) + proposed order form amendment — final alignment

Anna — thanks, all. Quick confirmation after our internal call with Legal and Privacy:

1) Audit & access — acceptable: quarterly remote log access + on-site with 14 days' notice for security-impacting reviews.
2) Data minimization — request Aurora add explicit examples of telemetry fields and a commitment to mask customer identifiers except for redacted troubleshooting (we will sign off once included).
3) Onward subcontracting — acceptable with prior written consent clause for security-impacting subvendors; 30-day notice for administrative/subsupport vendors.
4) KMS/tokens — noted, short-lived tokens are fine; please add language that EdgeCache may not persist tokens beyond 48 hours.

Kimberly will upload the final tracked-change counterproposal to the shared folder and Rishi will validate that the DPA language is GDPR-aligned for EU customers (we flagged an EU carve-out to be considered separately).

If Aurora can incorporate these changes into the DocuSign envelope, we can route for signature from Redwood Legal and close the loop. Target: sign by 2026-05-18 to keep your June 1 go-live.

Appreciate the rapid coordination.

Best,
Soojin
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
